title: Garnet Cable Cuff
descriptionHtml:
A twisted cable, finished in gold. A slim open cuff of twisted silver-tone cable, about 5mm thick, finished at each end with a gold barrel of two pavé rows and a round garnet-red stone set at the tip. The two tips sit face to face on top of the wrist, so the colour is always in view.

STYLING TIP: Stack it with a plain gold bangle so the gold ends have company.

Details

  • Style: Slim open cuff
  • Cable: Twisted silver tone cable, approximately 5mm thick
  • Ends: Gold tone barrels, approximately 9mm, each with two rows of clear pavé
  • Stones: One round garnet red stone at each tip
  • Inner width: Approximately 6cm
  • Finish: Silver tone cable with 18k gold tone ends

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
